name: Giovanni Battista Cima da Conegliano

summary.text: Giovanni Battista Cima, also called Cima da Conegliano, was an Italian Renaissance painter, who mostly worked in Venice.
summary.title: Cima da Conegliano

797913: The Madonna and Child with Saints Michael the Archangel and Andrew is an oil painting on panel by Cima da Conegliano, measuring 194x134 cm and dating to c. 1496–1498, in the Galleria nazionale di Parma.
Madonna and Child with Saints Michael the Archangel and Andrew
798814: The Montini Altarpiece is an oil on canvas painting by the Italian Renaissance artist Cima da Conegliano, dating from around 1506–1507 and housed in the Galleria Nazionale of Parma, Italy.
3395781: The Polyptych of Miglionico is a large, multicompartment Renaissance-style altarpiece painted in 1499 by Cima da Conegliano and housed in the church of Santa Maria Maggiore in the town of Miglionico, province of Matera, Basilicata, Italy.
3618176: The Annunciation is a 1495 oil on panel painting by Cima da Conegliano, now in the Hermitage Museum, in Saint Petersburg, Russia.
3621424: The Archangel Raphael and Tobias with Two Saints is an undated oil painting by Cima da Conegliano, now in the Gallerie dell'Accademia in Venice. To the left of the composition is Saint James the Great and to the right is Saint Nicholas of Bari.
The Archangel Raphael and Tobias with Two Saints
3636743: Baptism of Christ is a painting by Italian Renaissance painter Cima da Conegliano, dating from 1492. It is an oil painting on panel and is housed in the church of San Giovanni in Bragora in Venice.
3697643: Christ Enthroned is a tempera on panel painting with gold leaf background by Cima da Conegliano, painted before 1505. Christ is seated on a marble throne, two fingers of his right hand raised in a benediction, and the left hand holding a globus cruciger.
3842447: Madonna and Child is a 1512–1517 oil on canvas painting by Cima da Conegliano, now in the Rijksmuseum in Amsterdam.
3842448: Madonna and Child is an oil-on-panel painting by the Italian Renaissance painter Cima da Conegliano, created in 1495, now in the Pinacoteca Nazionale di Bologna. A studio copy also survives in the Holburne Museum in Bath, Somerset, United Kingdom.
3842449: Madonna and Child is an oil-on-panel painting by Cima da Conegliano, created in 1500, now in the National Museum of Wales in Cardiff.
3842450: Madonna and Child is a painting in oils on canvas of 1496–1499 by Cima da Conegliano. Previously in the L. M. and K. L. Kochubey collection, it was seized by the Soviet Union's State Museum Fund and in 1921 was handed to the Hermitage Museum in Saint Petersburg, where it still hangs.
3842451: Madonna and Child is a 1499–1502 oil on panel painting by Giovanni Battista Cima (1459-1517), now in the Detroit Institute of Arts, to which it was given in 1889 by James E. Scripps, having been in Scottish and English collections since around 1842.
3842452: Madonna and Child is an oil-on-panel painting created in 1504 by the Italian Renaissance painter Cima da Conegliano, now in the Museo nazionale atestino in Este. It is the most important pictorial work in the museum, which is mainly dedicated to archeology.
3842453: Madonna and Child is a 1496 oil on panel painting by Cima da Conegliano, now in the Museo Civico in Gemona del Friuli.
Madonna and Child (Cima, Gemona del Friuli)
3842455: The Virgin and Child is a 1496–1499 oil on panel painting by Cima da Conegliano, bought in 1858 by the National Gallery, London, where it still hangs.
3842456: The Virgin and Child is a 1499–1502 oil on panel painting by Cima da Conegliano, now in the National Gallery, London, to which it was bequeathed by George Salting in 1910.
3842457: The Virgin and Child is a 1505 oil on panel painting by Cima da Conegliano, now in the National Gallery, London, which bought it in 1860.
3842458: Madonna and Child is a 1496–1499 oil on panel painting by Cima da Conegliano, now in the Los Angeles County Museum of Art.
Madonna and Child in a Landscape (Cima, Los Angeles)
3842459: Madonna and Child is a 1504–1507 oil on panel painting by Cima da Conegliano, now in the Louvre, in Paris.
Madonna and Child (workshop of Cima, Paris)
3842460: The Madonna and Child is an oil painting on panel of 1495–1497 by the Italian Renaissance artist Cima da Conegliano, now in the Petit Palais in Paris.
3842461: Virgin and Child before a Landscape is an undated oil-on-panel painting by the Italian Renaissance artist Cima da Conegliano, now in the Philadelphia Museum of Art, which acquired it as part of the John G. Johnson collection in 1917.
Virgin and Child before a Landscape
3842462: Virgin and Child in a Landscape is a 1496–1499 oil on panel painting by Cima da Conegliano, now in the North Carolina Museum of Art, in Raleigh.
Virgin and Child in a Landscape (Cima, Raleigh)
3842464: Madonna and Child is an oil on panel painting by Cima da Conegliano, created c. 1504, that now hangs in the Uffizi in Florence. It has an early copy attributed to Antonio Maria da Carpi, now in the Musei civici di Padova.
3842465: Madonna and Child is a 1504 oil on panel painting by Cima da Conegliano, now in a private collection.
3842526: Madonna and Child with Saints is a 1515 oil on panel painting by Cima da Conegliano, now in the Cleveland Museum of Art, Ohio.
Virgin and Child with Saints and Donors
3842544: Madonna and Child Enthroned with Saints is a 1496–1498 oil painting by Cima da Conegliano, originally painted on panel but later transferred to canvas.
3842545: Madonna and Child Enthroned with Two Male Saints is a 1489 oil-on-panel painting by the Italian Renaissance painter Cima da Conegliano, previously owned by the church of San Dionisio in the Zermen district of Feltre and now in the Museo Civico in that town.
Madonna and Child Enthroned with Two Male Saints
3842546: Madonna and Child Enthroned with Two Virgin Martyrs is an oil on panel painting by Cima da Conegliano, created in 1495, now in the Memphis Brooks Museum of Art.
Madonna and Child Enthroned with Two Virgin Martyrs
3842549: Madonna and Child Enthroned with Saint James and Saint Jerome is a 1489 oil painting by Cima da Conegliano, originally painted on panel and later transferred to canvas.
Madonna and Child with Saints James the Great and Jerome (Cima)
3842551: Madonna and Child Enthroned with John the Baptist and Mary Magdalene is a 1511–1513 oil on panel painting by Cima da Conegliano.
Madonna and Child Enthroned with John the Baptist and Mary Magdalene
3842556: Madonna and Child with Saints is an undated oil-on-panel painting by the Italian Renaissance artist Cima da Conegliano, now in the Nivaagaards Malerisamling in Nivå, Denmark. Its dimensions are 71.5 cm x 102.5 cm.
Madonna and Child with Saints (Cima, Nivå)
3842557: The Virgin and Child with Saint Andrew and Saint Peter is an unfinished painting by an unknown artist in the studio of Cima da Conegliano. It is believed to have been created in the late 15th or early 16th century.
Virgin and Child with Saint Andrew and Saint Peter
3842570: Madonna and Child with Saint Francis and Saint Clare is an oil-on-panel painting created ca. 1492–1495 by the Italian Renaissance painter Cima da Conegliano, now in the Metropolitan Museum of Art, in New York.
Madonna and Child with Saint Francis and Saint Clare
3842571: Madonna and Child with Saint John the Baptist and Saint Catherine of Alexandria is a 1515 oil on canvas painting by Cima da Conegliano, now in the Morgan Library in New York.
Madonna and Child with Saints John the Baptist and Catherine of Alexandria (Cima)
3842572: Madonna and Child with Saint John the Baptist and Saint Francis is a 1489 oil-on-panel painting by the Italian Renaissance artist Cima da Conegliano, now in the Musée du Petit Palais in Avignon.
Madonna and Child with Saint John the Baptist and Saint Francis
3842576: The Virgin and Child with Saints is an oil-on-canvas painting attributed to Cima da Conegliano, created in 1513–1518, now in the National Gallery, London, to which it was bequeathed in 1916.
Virgin and Child with Saints (attributed to Cima)
3842578: Madonna and Child with Saint Jerome and Saint John the Baptist is an oil-on-panel painting executed ca. 1492–1495 by the Italian Renaissance painter Cima da Conegliano, now in the National Gallery of Art (NGA) in Washington.
Madonna and Child with Saint Jerome and Saint John the Baptist
3842579: Madonna and Child with Saint Jerome and Saint Mary Magdalene is a 1495 oil-on-panel painting by the Italian Renaissance painter Cima da Conegliano, now in the Alte Pinakothek, Munich, having been bought for the Bavarian royal collections in 1815 from the Empress Josephine's collection at Malmaison.
Madonna and Child with Saint Jerome and Saint Mary Magdalene
3842583: Madonna and Child with Saints is an oil on panel painting by Cima da Conegliano, created in 1504, now in the Gemäldegalerie, Berlin. From left to right the accompanying saints are Peter, Romuald, Benedict of Nursia and Paul.
Madonna and Child with Saints (Cima, Berlin)
3842588: Madonna and Child with Saints is a 1515 oil on canvas painting, now in the Fogg Art Museum in Cambridge (Massachusetts). Previously attributed to Cima da Conegliano, it is now attributed to an artist in the circle of Giovanni Bellini.
Madonna and Child with Saints (Fogg Art Museum)
3842644: Madonna of the Orange Tree is a 1496–1498 oil painting on panel by Cima da Conegliano. It was originally produced for the church of Santa Chiara in Murano, from which it was confiscated for the Gallerie dell'Accademia in Venice, where it now hangs.
3889238: The Conegliano Altarpiece or Madonna and Child with Angels and Saints is an oil painting produced in 1492 by Cima da Conegliano as the high altarpiece for the Duomo di Conegliano in his birthplace.
3907510: Olera Altarpiece is an oil on panel nine-panel altarpiece by Cima da Conegliano, created c. 1486–1488, housed in the parish church in Olera.
3910917: The Presentation of the Virgin Mary at the Temple is a painting by the Italian Renaissance master Cima da Conegliano, c. 1496–1497, in the Gemäldegalerie Alte Meister of Dresden, Germany, of the Presentation of Mary.
Presentation of the Virgin at the Temple (Cima)
3936372: Rest on the Flight into Egypt is a 1496–1498 oil on panel painting by Cima da Conegliano, now in the Calouste Gulbenkian Museum in Lisbon. Unusually for treatments of the scene, it also includes two saints, namely John the Baptist and Lucy.
Rest on the Flight into Egypt (Cima)
3944451: The Sacred Conversation or Madonna and Child Enthroned with praying brothers and devotees, Saint Sebastian, Saint John the Baptist, Saint Mary Magdalene and Saint Roch is a 1490 oil-on-panel painting by the Italian artist Cima da Conegliano, now in the Pinacoteca di Brera in Milan.
3947454: Saint Lanfranc Enthroned Between Saints John the Baptist and Liberius is an oil painting by Cima da Conegliano dating to c. 1515–1516. It is now in the Fitzwilliam Museum, Cambridge.
Saint Lanfranc Enthroned Between Saints John the Baptist and Liberius
3947826: Saint Peter Martyr with Saints Nicholas and Benedict is an oil painting on canvas by the Italian Renaissance painter Cima da Conegliano, created c. 1505–1506, now in the Pinacoteca di Brera in Milan.
Saint Peter Martyr with Saints Nicholas and Benedict
3949369: Saints Roch, Anthony Abbot and Lucy or Three Saints is a 1513 oil on canvas painting by Cima da Conegliano, which is now in the collection of the Metropolitan Museum of Art in New York.
Saints Roch, Anthony Abbot and Lucy
3984955: Theseus Killing the Minotaur is an oil-on-panel painting by Cima da Conegliano, created c. 1505, now in the Museo Poldi Pezzoli in Milan. It depicts a scene of Greek mythology, when Theseus killed the Minotaur in Crete's labyrinth.
4016335: Head of a Female Saint is an undated oil on panel painting by Cima da Conegliano, now in the Museo Poldi Pezzoli in Milan. It depicts an unknown female saint, since there are no visible attributes that can help to her identification.
16574825: Madonna and Child is an oil-on-panel painting created ca. 1500–1504 by the Italian artist Cima da Conegliano, now in the Minneapolis Institute of Arts.
43539727: Madonna and Child with Saint Catherine and Saint Nicholas is a 1510-1517 oil on canvas painting by Cima da Conegliano, now on long-term loan to the Yale University Art Gallery from the Barker Welfare Foundation in memory of Catherine Barker and Charles V. Hickox.
Madonna and Child with Saint Catherine and Saint Nicholas
75855183: The Bacchic Cassone was a 1505–1510 panel painting by Cima da Conegliano, produced as the front panel of a decorated cassone. It is now split into four portions, one in a private collection, two in the Philadelphia Museum of Art and one in the Museo Poldi Pezzoli in Milan.
85851422: The Mestre Altarpiece was a c. 1500–1502 altarpiece by Cima da Conegliano.
